shortDescription: Join queues remotely and keep every customer visit moving.
fullDescription:
QueueWise helps customers spend less time waiting and gives merchants a clear view of their service queue.

For customers:
• Discover participating businesses and view queue availability.
• Join a queue remotely and track your place in real time.
• Check in with a QR code when you arrive.
• Receive queue progress and call notifications.
• Review your completed queue history.

For merchants:
• Open, pause, and close the service queue.
• Add walk-in customers and manage waiting entries.
• Call, serve, complete, skip, or mark entries as no-shows.
• Review operational queue analytics.

QueueWise keeps customers informed and helps service teams run a more orderly line. Available features depend on participating businesses and notification permissions.
